title: WorldCupVoice
tagline: Add visually grounded AI voice commentary to live sports streams.
description: Build an AI commentator that watches an Agora RTC video feed, generates play-by-play from sampled frames, and publishes synthesized speech and synchronized transcripts back into the live channel.
author: zicojiao
